analysis:
The PR touches only docs/architecture/inference.md. Two changed ranges are visible: the 'Last updated' date on line 3 (2026-10-25 to 2026-10-26) and one added troubleshooting table row at head line ~2556. The row describes a provider crash ('Trace/BPT trap: 5') caused by a failed MLX Metal JIT compile on M5 GPUs, fixed in 0.10.3. The supplied units (base lines 1-805) show no changes other than line 3. The added row is only partly visible in the truncated patch excerpt, and its trailing file references are cut off.

No code, config, key handling, attestation, authorization, or cache behavior changes. T-041 (prefix cache) and the other threat entries are not affected: the doc text on prefix-cache TTL, HMAC lookup tags, scope partitioning and encrypted SSD checkpoints is unchanged. The documented behavior is not altered by this PR.

The only security-adjacent point is the described crash. It is a self-inflicted availability issue on M5 hardware that a prompt could in principle trigger (long prompts with head dim 256/512). It is documented as already fixed in 0.10.3. The docs state a fix exists, but that fix is outside the supplied evidence, so I cannot verify it. It is not a regression introduced by this PR, and no threat-model update is required.

Limitation: the patch excerpt is truncated, so the full added row and any further hunks beyond the visible range are unseen. The rest of the file beyond base line 805 was not supplied in these units.
